title: Pickleball Chaos
style: Comedy pop-rock with a fast driving tempo, bouncy offbeat rhythm, and crisp handclaps; verse rides tight guitar stabs and playful bass hits, pre-chorus speeds up with snare rolls and shouted responses, chorus bursts wide with gang vocals and cheeky chant lines. Lead vocal is bright, punchy, and conversational with doubled hook words, little ad-lib laughs, and quick delay throws on punchlines. Add whistled fills, sneaker squeaks, and a short crowd-count riser into each chorus. Mix is glossy, loud, and rubbery, built for instant sing-along energy.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Got me on the court in thongs and a grin
Tiny little paddle, still I’m going in
Serve hit the tape, then it skids like a snake
I swing like I mean it, then laugh at the fake

Your lob went sky high, mate, straight to the bin
I yelled “good shot!” while I barely got in
One more cheeky dink, now the whole crew’s shook
We came for a game, left with bruises and a look

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh no, here it comes again
Too fast, too funny, my friend
Line call drama, I’m not dead
I just got clipped by the edge

[Chorus]
Pickleball chaos, pickleball fun
Smash it, miss it, still keep runnin’
Pickleball chaos, pickleball bite
Laugh all day, then play all night
(Oh yeah)
Pickleball chaos, pickleball wild
One more rally, everybody smiled

[Verse 2]
Old mate from Brisbane brought a cracked-up cap
Said “I’m here for sport,” then he nearly tapped
Dink to the kitchen, that shot’s pure gold
Then you pop one back like it’s turning to stone

Someone yelled “mine!” with a feral tone
Then two of us swung and the ball went home
Short little rally, then a big dumb pause
We all blame the wind like that’s the cause

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh no, here it comes again
Too quick, too tricky, my friend
You can scuff your pride, lose face
Still grin when you miss the pace

[Chorus]
Pickleball chaos, pickleball fun
Smash it, miss it, still keep runnin’
Pickleball chaos, pickleball bite
Laugh all day, then play all night
(Oh yeah)
Pickleball chaos, pickleball wild
One more rally, everybody smiled

[Bridge]
Boots on the bench, knees in a moan
“Just one more set” turns into ten home
Sweat on the grip, sun in our eyes
Still we’re out there chasing surprise

[Final Chorus]
Pickleball chaos, pickleball fun
Smash it, miss it, still keep runnin’
Pickleball chaos, pickleball bite
Laugh all day, then play all night
(Too good!)
Pickleball chaos, pickleball wild
One more rally, everybody smiled
